events.body:
ACK f82c4612768827ea26e7b08cc895696db61bf073

Checked that the values here line up with the ones on the website and plugged them into core and was able to sync with them.

The version should probably bumped to 0.4.0 with this update.

ACK @fjahr @ajtowns here is a suggested updated version for the feedback:
updated version diff

```diff diff --git a/bip-0095.md b/bip-0095.md index a47f9b7a..6cc0655c 100644 --- a/bip-0095.md +++ b/bip-0095.md @@ -9,7 +9,7 @@ Assigned: 2026-06-22 License: CC0-1.0 Discussion: 2026-06-02: https://groups.google.com/g/bitcoindev/c/kGUMTxOvdJA - Version: 0.3.0 + Version: 0.4.0 Requires: 54 Replaces: 94 @@ -76,35 +76,27 @@ from block 1, as specified above. ### Genesis Block -TODO: Mine the block. The values below are placeholders. They are -the genesis block's header fields together with the `Message` and -`scriptPubKey` of its coinbase transaction. Notes for the miner: - -- `scriptPubKey` is the script public key in the coinbase transaction's - output. It is `OP_RETURN` followed by a push of 8-bytes of extranonce - space, as it is unspendable in any event, and this avoids bike shedding - over its content. - `Message` is a string in the coinbase input script, and carries a recent Bitcoin mainnet block hash as an anti-pre-mine commitment, serving the same purpose as the newspaper headline in Bitcoin's mainnet genesis block. +- `scriptPubKey` is the script public key in the coinbase transaction's + output. It is `OP_RETURN` followed by a push of 8-bytes of extranonce + space, as it is unspendable in any event, and this avoids bike shedding + over its content. - `Time stamp` is the time of mining or that of the block which hash is used in `Message` - `nBits` is `0x1a0fffff`, per the raised minimum difficulty. - `Version` is used for version-rolling to meet the difficulty. -Placeholders: + * Message: "2026-11-14 975744 0000000000000000000123e2681e2f82acdcb9430a15eec24cc85b400691d479" + * scriptPubKey: 6a0895ebf76a02000000 + * Time stamp: 1794632593 + * Nonce: 0x653d9131 + * nBits: 0x1a0fffff + * Version: 0x2230c000 -> (Note, these values have the wrong nBits value (too low difficulty) and are pre-mined so are not suitable for use) -> -> * Message: "2026-11-03 974343 00000000000000000000a86d6da2c1563d08668d9ec18cce58cb8c865d4a31c8" -> * scriptPubKey: 0x6a089763e96a00000000 -> * Time stamp: 1793680278 -> * Nonce: 0x73ba1699 -> * nBits: 0x1b07fff8 -> * Version: 0x201c4000 -> -> The resulting Genesis block hash is 000000000001bd3ade1e24d07c1a3677d4868c34f2f1696fa419e3b9f061b1e0, and the block hex is . +The resulting Genesis block hash is 00000000000008c1637e7d3252dc1c333d4546fd6fff6a474b200d674a91d497, and the block hex is . ### Message Start @@ -178,10 +170,11 @@ This document is licensed under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal license. ## Changelog +* __0.4.0__ (2026-11-14): + * Add mined Testnet 5 genesis block parameters. * __0.3.0__ (2026-11-05): * Move commitment back to scriptSig, and use `OP_RETURN` for output. * __0.2.0__ (2026-11-05): * Change default P2P port from 18335 to 18353 * __0.1.0__ (2026-06-02): * Initial draft - ```

> The version should probably bumped to 0.4.0 with this update.

Given that Testnet 5 is now deployed, I would suggest bumping to 1.0.0 instead and advancing the BIP to Deployed.

events.message: BIP95: Add testnet5 genesis parameters, bump to 1.0.0/Deployed

events.body: Okay, bumped to 1.0.0; added the genesis params rationale in the rationale section and reworded it a bit; also added references to the launch post and bip320.
